notes.title: Stage4 Boss Update Patch
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!
Welcome to the world of Virtual Buster.

We're very excited to announce the new boss update for Stage 4 that you've all been waiting for. This update introduces even more powerful giant bosses that will test your fighting skills.

Get ready for a new challenge. Develop a strategy, gather your team, defeat this massive enemy and claim the glory of victory. It's time to show your courage and skills.

Download the update now and experience a new chapter of Virtual Buster!

thank you
